question: Chosen Foods parent company owner
markdown:
Chosen Foods is owned by the Los Angeles-based private equity firm **Butterfly Equity**, which acquired a majority stake in the company in September 2021. More details can be found on [⁠Butterfly Equity - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butterfly_Equity) and [⁠Avocado products maker Chosen Foods gets new majority ownership](https://www.just-food.com/news/avocado-products-maker-chosen-foods-gets-new-majority-ownership/).

-   **Parent Firm:** Butterfly Equity (specializes in food and beverage investments). You can read the official investment announcement via [⁠Kirkland Represents Butterfly on Investment in Chosen Foods](https://www.kirkland.com/news/press-release/2021/09/kirkland-represents-butterfly-on-investment-in-cho).

-   **Founders:** Chosen Foods was originally founded in 2011 by Carsten Hagen, George Todd, and Sioma Waisburd. [](https://www.just-food.com/news/avocado-products-maker-chosen-foods-gets-new-majority-ownership/)

-   **Sale Exploration:** [⁠Chosen Foods' owner explores sale of avocado products maker - Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/chosen-foods-owner-explores-sale-avocado-based-food-products-maker-sources-say-2024-03-19/) outlines reports regarding potential transactions for the brand.

If you would like, I can provide more information on:

-   Chosen Foods' **flagship products**
-   Other brands owned by **Butterfly Equity**
-   Current **leadership** of Chosen Foods
